product_overview: JobPilot is a Flask backend that verifies live job postings from Greenhouse/Lever, filters them by a strict four-condition Core Promise (open, location, direction, identity), parses user resumes via Claude, and generates tailored cover letters and paid features via Stripe.
core_goals: Ensure every job returned to users satisfies the Core Promise (open + location + direction + identity).
Provide reliable resume parsing and structured user profiles to drive personalized searches and cover letter generation.
Offer a smooth, auditable paid upgrade flow via Stripe and webhook processing.
Expose lightweight admin maintenance endpoints for ops tasks while preventing accidental misuse.
Give developers and ops transparent health/debug endpoints for monitoring and troubleshooting.

features.name: Health and Debug
features.description: Liveness probe and database introspection endpoints for ops and monitoring.
user_flows: GET /api/health -> Receive 200 {"status":"string"} indicating service is up
GET /api/debug/tables -> Receive 200 {"tables":{...}} with table names and row counts
GET /api/health -> Receive 503 {"status":"service_unavailable"} when DB or dependencies are unreachable (error flow)
GET /api/debug/tables -> Receive 500 {"error":"DB error"} when DB query fails (error flow)

features.name: User Authentication and Profile
features.description: Sync Google OAuth users into Postgres and return the current authenticated user profile.
user_flows: POST /api/sync-user with body {"email":"user@example.com","name":"User Name","image":"https://..."} -> Receive 200 {"id":123,"email":"user@example.com"} (happy path)
GET /api/me with session cookie or auth token -> Receive 200 with full user profile (happy path continuation)
POST /api/sync-user with body {"name":"NoEmail"} -> Receive 400 Validation error (error flow: missing email)
GET /api/me without session cookie or token -> Receive 401 Unauthorized (error flow)

features.name: Resume Parsing
features.description: Accepts a PDF/DOCX resume, extracts plaintext, and calls Claude to return structured fields (skills, degree, direction, experience).
user_flows: POST /api/parse with multipart/form-data file (PDF or DOCX) and auth -> Receive 200 {"skills":[...],"degree":"MS","direction":"Software","experience":"3 years"} (happy path)
POST /api/parse with malformed or unsupported file and auth -> Receive 400 Invalid file (error flow)
POST /api/parse with valid file but Claude API times out -> Receive 500 Parser error (error flow)

features.name: Job Search (Promise-Gated)
features.description: Core search endpoint: queries the verified job cache and enforces the Core Promise filter (open, location, direction, identity).
user_flows: POST /api/search with body {"direction":"Software","region":"US","degree":"MS","visa_needed":false} and auth -> Receive 200 {"jobs":[...],"search_id":456} where each job passes passes_core_promise() (happy path)
POST /api/search with body {"direction":"Software","region":"Mars","degree":"MS","visa_needed":false} and auth -> Receive 400 Validation error for invalid region (error flow)
POST /api/search without auth -> Receive 401 Unauthorized (error flow)

POST /api/search with body that would match jobs failing Core Promise (e.g., job flagged no_sponsor) and auth -> Receive 200 {"jobs":[]} with empty results because promise gate filtered them (happy-path for gate enforcement)

features.name: Cover Letter Generation
features.description: Generate a Claude-authored cover letter for a selected job using the user's parsed resume. Supports both blocking JSON responses and SSE streaming.
user_flows: POST /api/generate-cls with body {"job_id":789,"resume_text":"..."} and auth -> Receive 200 {"cover_letter":"Dear Hiring Manager,..."} (happy path blocking)
GET /api/generate-cls/stream?search_id=456&job_id=789 with auth -> Receive 200 text/event-stream with incremental tokens until completion (happy path streaming)
POST /api/generate-cls with invalid job_id and auth -> Receive 400 Validation error (error flow)
POST /api/generate-cls with valid request but Claude API error occurs -> Receive 500 Claude API error (error flow)
GET /api/generate-cls/stream without auth -> Receive 401 Unauthorized (error flow)

features.name: Demo Verification
features.description: Public endpoint that verifies whether a single job URL is currently open and accepting applications.
user_flows: GET /api/demo-verify?url=https://company.jobs/123 -> Receive 200 {"verified_open":true,"confidence":"high"} (happy path)
GET /api/demo-verify?url=https://company.jobs/closed -> Receive 200 {"verified_open":false,"confidence":"medium"} (happy path: closed result)
GET /api/demo-verify without url query param -> Receive 400 Missing URL (error flow)
GET /api/demo-verify?url=http://internal.local -> Receive 200 or 500 depending on server-side fetch policy (error flow demonstrating SSRF risk if not allowlisted)

features.name: Stripe Payments
features.description: Create Stripe Checkout sessions for paid plans and process webhook events to upgrade users.
user_flows: POST /api/stripe/create-checkout with auth -> Receive 200 {"url":"https://checkout.stripe.com/..."} (happy path: checkout created)
POST /api/stripe/webhook with header Stripe-Signature set to valid signature and raw Stripe payload -> Receive 200 {"received":true} and user status upgraded (happy path)
POST /api/stripe/webhook with invalid or missing Stripe-Signature header -> Receive 400 Invalid signature (error flow)
POST /api/stripe/create-checkout with auth but Stripe service error -> Receive 500 Stripe error (error flow)

features.name: Search History Export
features.description: Download a CSV of a stored search or export an ad-hoc job list as CSV.
user_flows: GET /api/download/456 with auth -> Receive 200 text/csv stream containing the exported search results (happy path)
GET /api/download/99999 with auth -> Receive 404 Not found when search_id doesn't exist (error flow)
POST /api/export-direct with auth and body {"jobs":[...] } -> Receive 200 text/csv with the ad-hoc exported CSV (happy path)

features.name: Admin Maintenance
features.description: Admin-only endpoints protected by ADMIN_SECRET for ops tasks: migrate, refresh, backfill, reseed, and repair job data.
user_flows: POST /api/admin/daily-refresh with ADMIN_SECRET in auth -> Receive 200 {"started":true} and background refresh triggered (happy path)
POST /api/admin/migrate with ADMIN_SECRET in auth -> Receive 200 {"migrations_applied":true} (happy path)
POST /api/admin/wipe-and-reseed without ADMIN_SECRET or with invalid secret -> Receive 401 Unauthorized (error flow: prevents accidental misuse)
POST /api/admin/backfill-degree with ADMIN_SECRET in auth -> Receive 200 {"rows_updated":N} or 500 on failure (error flow for backfill failure)

known_limitations.issue: ADMIN_SECRET-based admin auth is a shared bearer token; no per-user RBAC
known_limitations.impact: Anyone with the secret can wipe/reseed the job database

known_limitations.issue: /api/demo-verify takes an arbitrary URL with no allowlist
known_limitations.impact: Server-side fetch can be pointed at internal hosts (SSRF risk)

known_limitations.issue: Cover letter generation has no rate limiting per user
known_limitations.impact: A single user can exhaust Claude API quota / spend

known_limitations.issue: Stripe webhook processing assumes signature verification succeeds before parsing
known_limitations.impact: Bad signature should reject early; double-check ordering

known_limitations.issue: /api/sync-user trusts the email from the request body
known_limitations.impact: Without server-side OAuth verification a caller could impersonate any user

known_limitations.issue: db.create_all() side-effect must run on import for gunicorn
known_limitations.impact: Refactors that move it inside __main__ silently break production
